img.caption: Fig 3: Calibration quality and refusal behavior. Left: Expected Calibration Error (15-bin, lower is better); right: intra-domain false-reject rate. QP-OneModel over-refuses 86% of in-domain CLINC150 queries but has no built-in rejection gate on multi-intent generation benchmarks (hatched). MULACONF rejects 100% of MixATIS and 82% of MixSNIPS in-domain queries. CICC is a single-label baseline, not evaluated on multi-intent data (hatched). Ours attains the lowest ECE on CLINC150 (0.005) and MixSNIPS (0.045) while keeping false rejection bounded at 4.6-20.8%.
